operator_notes: News & Events lists weekly Parish bulletin PDFs under /media/other/31871/ — newest is at the top.
Use first_match on that folder path; do not use bare *.pdf (archive has 190+ PDFs and times out).
Filenames are YY-MM-DD (e.g. 26-08-02.pdf). Example href/url is illustrative only — pick_strategy selects the current top bulletin.
do_not: Do not pin one weekly PDF filename as the permanent solution.
Do not use url_pattern *.pdf on the full news page.
Do not pick GDPR/admin/financial PDFs outside the 31871 bulletin folder.
